heroHeadline: ISW: Russia's Advance Rate Collapses Two-Thirds in a Year — Victory Day Parade Stripped of All Military Hardware as Ukraine's 347-Drone Attack Shuts Moscow Airports
heroSubtitle: Ukraine launched its second-largest drone attack of the war on May 7 (347 drones across 20 Russian regions, disrupting all three Moscow airports), a direct response to Russia violating Ukraine's open-ended ceasefire 1,820 times in a single morning. The Institute for the Study of War reported Russia suffered a net territorial loss of 116 sq km in April 2026 — the first monthly net loss since late 2022 — with its daily advance rate down from 9.76 sq km/day to 2.9 sq km/day. For the first time in two decades, Russia's Victory Day parade was stripped of all tanks, missiles, and jets due to fears of Ukrainian long-range strikes, while Ukraine simultaneously struck a Crimean electrical substation and a Russian Caspian Sea warship. Diplomatically, Slovakia's Fico accepted a Kyiv visit invitation (reversing his EU obstruction) and Hungary's new government returned $82M to Ukraine's Oschadbank.
